title: RenderReportMessage
description: Motion client to runtime: a report of the render host, which the motion worker forwards unchanged (SPEC.md section 11; ADR-0003 1a: the stimulus window's main thread returns only its frame log and clock reports). kind ready: the warm-up report; frames: a batch of the frame log; long_tasks: long-task and long-animation-frame entries; clock: a frame-clock check result.

time_origin_us.description: performance.timeOrigin of the render host's realm, in whole microseconds. It names the clock domain of every *_us time in the report (the render host's performance.now()), which differs from the motion worker's; it is not itself a timestamp.

ready.title: RenderReady
ready.description: Sent once, after every world, material and texture is warmed up and before any trial (ADR-0003 1b): from then on a rise in programs or textures is a fault the frame log flags.

host.description: Which render host draws the stimulus: main (the scene window's main thread) or worker (an OffscreenCanvas worker, ADR-0003 Decision 3).

fallback_reason.description: Why the main-thread host is used although a worker host was asked for.

warmup_us.description: How long loading and warm-up took.

refresh_hz.description: Refresh rate of the display the scene window is on, as Electron reports it.

settings.description: Effective renderer settings by name, for example {"shadows": false, "toneMapping": "NoToneMapping"} (plan item REN-3).

assets.description: Every asset the scene loaded, by id, with the SHA-256 of its bytes.

setting.title: RenderSetting
setting.description: A setting's value: a boolean, a number or a constant's name.

frames.title: RenderFrames
frames.description: Frame-log records in frame order, at most 1 s of frames per batch (plan item REN-11).

world.description: The world every frame in the batch showed: a batch never spans a world switch.

frame.title: FrameRecord
frame.description: One requestAnimationFrame callback of the render host (ADR-0003 1d). Times are on the render host's clock.
Frame index: 0 for the first callback after ready, then +1 per callback.

seq.description: The sample whose pose was drawn, or the earlier of two when the frame interpolated between poses. Absent before the first pose.

seq_next.description: The later of the two samples when the frame interpolated between poses.

t_dev_us.description: The device time the drawn pose stands for. Absent before the first pose.

flags.description: Bit 0 (1): screen blanked. Bit 1 (2): motion frozen. Bit 2 (4): document hidden. Bit 3 (8): WebGL context lost. Bit 4 (16): shader programs or textures rose after ready. Bits 5-7: reserved, 0.

long_tasks.title: RenderLongTasks
long_tasks.description: Long tasks the render host's main thread observed (plan item REN-12), in the order observed.

long_task.title: LongTaskEntry
long_task.description: One PerformanceObserver entry, or one of the app's own timed handlers above the threshold. Script attribution is left out, because it holds file URLs.

entry.description: longtask or long-animation-frame (PerformanceEntry.entryType), or handler (timed by the app).

clock.title: RenderClockCheck
clock.description: A result of the display-based frame-clock check (ADR-0003 1d; plan item REN-4): the 5 s self-test after ready, then rolling results. It has no gain field.

pass.description: Median frame rate within 1 % (at least 1 Hz) of the display's refresh rate, and spread under 0.5 ms.

intervals.description: Frame intervals the result is based on.

display_hz.description: The display's refresh rate the median was compared with.

spread_us.description: 95th minus 5th percentile of the frame intervals.
